Fed & Policy Watch
  • SOFR 3.92% effective Nov 20; NFCI -0.478 for week ending Nov 13; MOVE 100.91 and 10-year Treasury 4.92% on Nov 23. These are lagged observations, not live funding measures. Next NFCI release is Nov 25 at 8:30 AM ET, week ending Nov 20.
  • Beige Book is dated Nov 25: Board calendar gives 2:00 PM ET and Chicago Fed calendar lists a general 3:00 PM ET release time; the date-specific Board time is displayed with caveat. H.6 is scheduled today at 1:00 PM ET. October FOMC minutes released Nov 18 are elapsed. Next FOMC meeting Dec 8-9; statement Dec 9 at 2:00 PM and press conference at 2:30 PM.
  • Thanksgiving: the Board marks Nov 26 as a holiday and says statistical releases scheduled that day move to Nov 27. Selected verified Friday releases include claims, Census Advance Economic Indicators and H.4.1. No exchange-hours claim is made.
  • Energy and Treasury supply: EIA petroleum follows its standard Wednesday 10:30 AM ET schedule Nov 25; natural gas storage is listed at noon. TreasuryDirect lists bill auctions today and a 7-year note auction tomorrow; see the calendar for verified bid-close times.
Omissions and Watch
  • Date conflict: New York Fed November calendar lists Personal Income and the PCE Deflator on Nov 25 at 8:30 AM without a period. BEA's direct schedule instead lists Personal Income and Outlays for October on Dec 2 at 8:30 AM and November on Dec 23 at 8:30 AM. Nov 25 is retained only as a conflicting New York Fed calendar entry, not represented as BEA-confirmed October PCE; verify any official calendar correction.
  • Beige Book timing conflict: Board's date-specific calendar gives Nov 25 at 2:00 PM ET, while Chicago Fed lists the date and a general 3:00 PM ET release time. Board date-specific time is shown, with caveat.
  • BLS pages were not requested; BLS release dates/times were checked on the New York Fed Economic Indicators Calendar as directed. Conference Board and Richmond Fed primary schedule pages are outside the available fetch route; their date/time entries are cited from the New York Fed's date-specific calendar. Event periods are not inferred when a source gives none.
  • The Nov 23 Chicago Fed CFNAI and CFSEC entries are elapsed and excluded; the cutoff also removes any other past entries. Thanksgiving Nov 26 has no event row in the selected checked calendars; Board confirms the holiday and transfer of its scheduled daily/weekly statistical releases to Friday. Selected calendars are not an exhaustive inventory of every publisher release or exchange schedule.
  • Sources checked: New York Fed November/December Economic Indicators calendars and SOFR API; Federal Reserve Board November/December calendars and H.4.1; BEA schedule; Census 2026 calendar; Chicago Fed release calendar and NFCI CSV; Philadelphia Fed survey route; EIA petroleum/natural-gas schedules; TreasuryDirect upcoming auctions; U.S. Treasury yields. Market quotes are single-source Yahoo Finance.
  • No verified unscheduled policy or geopolitical watch item from this run; this is not a full headline-risk review. Material verified watches: funding/conditions, Treasury supply, holiday-adjusted energy releases, the Beige Book timing discrepancy, and the New York Fed/BEA PCE date conflict.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
Monday SPY rebounded 4.71% after Friday's selloff; VIX eased to 26.62 and MOVE to 100.91, while the 10-year held at 4.92%. ES is only modestly higher overnight. Treat this as a recovery attempt, not confirmation of a durable trend reversal. Wednesday's GDP, durable goods, NFCI, energy data and Beige Book, followed by a Thanksgiving-shortened trading week, raise event and liquidity sensitivity. Look for confirmation in rates, breadth and cash-market participation; avoid assuming overnight direction persists. Scenario framing only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess the constructive recovery case if ES gives back the overnight gains alongside renewed volatility, or if data, Treasury auctions or the Beige Book materially reprice yields. No unsupported levels or targets supplied. Refresh quotes and verify contract specifications and holiday-session liquidity before execution.
